brief: An AI-assisted configuration control plane that lets non-technical business operators change ERP and CRM data models, layouts and workflows through conversation, without compromising compliance, security or uptime.
criteria: Success: simple, clean and modern; distinct from blue enterprise software; recognisable at 16 px; works in one colour.

concepts.name: Talk Switch
concepts.idea: A speech bubble that is also a switch: say it, and it's set.
rationale: Shows the whole product in one shape: a conversation that sets a live configuration
The mint knob marks the live, switched-on state and stays calm against deep pine
Green stands apart from the blue used widely across enterprise software
The pill matches the wordmark's height, and the tail drops below the baseline with the p

recommendation: Talk Switch: one clear idea that non-technical operators understand at a glance.
next_steps: Confirm print colours against a physical Pantone guide
Roll out to product, website and sales materials
